# Ramble

> Ramble for Apple Watch: one-way voice notes from your Apple Watch to your agent. Say it and let it go: nothing replies on the watch, and it records with no phone or signal and sends later. Tap the watch and talk; the watch sends the recording straight to Ramble's server, which transcribes it and holds the text until your agent picks it up. No accounts.

Pairing: in Ramble on iPhone, Settings → Your agent → Connect your agent copies a message with a single-use code like K7QX-MP4D-HN3R. The user pastes it to their agent. The agent exchanges the code for a token, then pulls new transcripts and acknowledges them, which deletes them.

Privacy: Ramble's server is a relay, not an archive. Your audio is sent to a transcription provider and deleted as soon as the transcript is ready. Transcripts are deleted when your agent picks them up, or after 30 days. Your full history lives only on your iPhone. Ramble also keeps basic usage stats for each note, like its length and whether it came from your watch or iPhone, under a random ID. Never your audio or your words.

Transcription: Groq Whisper v3 Turbo, the only provider. When Groq is overloaded or down, the note waits and is retried.

Price: Free to try. 25 notes free, then $14.99 once. No subscription.

Relay: https://api.ramble.watch (https://ramble-transcription-proxy.jpoliachik.workers.dev serves the identical API)

Ramble can also send each transcript to an HTTPS endpoint (webhook) from the iPhone.

## Docs

- [Full reference](https://ramble.watch/llms-full.txt): Agent connection, the relay API, the webhook API, and troubleshooting.
- [Connect your agent](https://ramble.watch/docs): Pairing, the agent loop, wake-up hooks, errors, and the relay API.
- [Webhooks](https://ramble.watch/docs/webhooks): Payload format, signature verification, retries, automation platforms.
- [Requirements and troubleshooting](https://ramble.watch/docs/help): Minimum iOS and watchOS, and fixes for a missing watch app, notes waiting on the watch, held notes, transcription errors, and an agent that isn't picking up.
- [Support](https://ramble.watch/support): support@ramble.watch, restoring a purchase, refunds.

Requirements: iPhone on iOS 18.6 or later. Apple Watch on watchOS 10.0 or later (Series 4 and later, any SE, any Ultra). If the watch app doesn't appear after installing, the watch is usually on an older watchOS.
